name: CI
display_title: [XLA:GPU] Scale intermediate tile sizes by byte width in EstimateNumWarps.

head_commit.message:
[XLA:GPU] Scale intermediate tile sizes by byte width in EstimateNumWarps.

`EstimateNumWarps` previously computed `largest_live_tile_size` using raw padded element counts across all instructions in the tiled computation. For fusions with broadcasted inputs, `iota`, or sub-32-bit intermediate tiles (such as `pred` comparisons feeding a reduction), this inflated `largest_live_tile_size` by 4x or more and selected 4-8 warps where 2-4 warps are faster.

Introduce `GetLiveTileSizeForNumWarps`:

- Keep full padded element counts for operands and roots so global memory vectorization is unchanged.
- Ignore non-root `broadcast` and `constant` tiles, which do not materialize a separate register array beyond their operands, and size non-root `iota` by its 1D range along `iota_dimension`.
- Scale other intermediate array tiles by `min(element_bytes, 4) / 4` (32-bit register words).

Also account for multi-block SM residency (`blocks_per_core`) when computing `active_threads_per_core` in `EstimateRunTimeForTiledHloComputationImpl` so that 1-warp and 2-warp candidates on multi-wave grids are not penalized as if only a single block could reside on each SM.

PiperOrigin-RevId: 1006120810

name: CI
display_title: [XLA] Keep returned values alive in region-based copy elision

head_commit.message:
[XLA] Keep returned values alive in region-based copy elision

A value held by the root of a computation is returned by it and stays live
until the computation ends, even though it has no explicit use there. The
region-based live range analysis in CopyRemover only recorded definitions and
explicit uses, so an instruction of that computation that modifies the buffer
after the root was considered to run after the live range had ended.
CopyRemover then elided the copy that separated the in-place modification from
the returned value.

This surfaced for an entry parameter that is also the entry root and is
modified in place by a side effecting custom call whose aliased output is
otherwise dead: RemoveUnnecessaryCopies elided the copy that
AddCopiesToResolveInterference had inserted, and AddSpecialCaseCopies then
routed both the root and the in-place operation through the same copy of the
parameter, so the result observed the in-place modification.

Record in the live range regions which instructions return a value of the live
range (the root is not necessarily a user of the value), and let
ComputeRelativeLocation treat a modifying instruction that runs after such a
root within its computation as lying within the live range. This is the
region-based counterpart of the root checks in CopyRemover::LiveRangeBefore and
HloOrdering::LiveRangeStrictlyBefore.
